description: This file defines the TaskListScreen widget and associated components for a Flutter task management app. It displays a list of tasks, allows filtering by status, and provides functionality to add, edit, toggle, and delete tasks.

classes.name: TaskListScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of tasks with filter and action buttons.

classes.name: _FilterBar
classes.description: Widget displaying filter options as chips for task filtering.

classes.name: _TaskList
classes.description: Widget that builds and displays the list of task items, with editing and deletion capabilities.

methods.name: build (in TaskListScreen)
methods.description: Builds the main scaffold with app bar, filter bar, task list, and floating action button.

methods.name: build (in _FilterBar)
methods.description: Constructs a row of filter chips for task filtering.

methods.name: build (in _TaskList)
methods.description: Builds the task list view or a placeholder message if no tasks are present.
